item.title: Here’s what stores are open, and which ones are closed, on Christmas
item.description: From department stores to grocery stores, most retailers across the U.S. close early on Christmas Eve and shut their doors entirely on Christmas Day — while others opt to cut back hours. But there’s also a handful of businesses that will be open during the holiday.

item.title: Turkey shoot a holiday tradition, with no ruffled feathers
item.description: With the blast of a shotgun, the Raleigh Moose Family Center Turkey Shoot is under way. But fear not: No gobblers were harmed in the making of this holiday fun.

item.title: Local ‘Saint Nick’ spreads Christmas cheer by raising donations for elderly residents
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — Saint Nick is raising donations for elderly members of the community this Christmas. The Saint Nicholas Christmas Foundation is a nonprofit organization that provides Christmas gifts to residents of assisted living without family in Brunswick and surrounding counties. Wish lists are posted on the organization’s website, and the community comes through with donations to make sure assisted living residents have some extra Christmas joy. item.title: Missing packages are the latest example of ongoing mail delivery issues in Leland
item.description: BRUNSWICK COUNTY (WWAY) — “I don’t even know where this package is,” said Amber Marco. Amber Marco never expected to spend the days before Christmas hunting for a missing holiday gift. She lives on Pinecliff Drive, a dirt road approximately 0.4 miles away from her standard size mailbox. But the journey there is only half of the battle.
